label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: Ring Imaging Cherenkov detector: the radiator plane of 92 aerogel and 16 NaF tiles

quantities.name: aerogel_tiles
quantities.definition: number of aerogel tiles (tag aerogel_tile) in the expanded IR
quantities.derivation: 92 tiles of 113 x 113 x 25 mm3 (ams02:C70, S01 Section 1.6)

independence.result: a design count from the tier-1 review, not a simulation output; the tile layout is a construction chosen to give it (ams02:C206), so the count checks how the layout is expressed, not the AMS arrangement

negative_control.change: the website's 115 mm tile (instead of S01's 113 mm) as size and pitch

quantities.name: naf_tiles
quantities.definition: number of NaF tiles (tag naf_tile) in the expanded IR

independence.result: a design count from the tier-1 review, not a simulation output; checks how the 4 x 4 array is expressed

negative_control.change: one row of the NaF array missing (3 x 4)

quantities.name: aerogel_cherenkov_angle
quantities.definition: mean polar angle, in rad, of the Cherenkov photons a 10 GeV (kinetic) mu- emits in an aerogel tile, detected inside the tile's own medium (per-event means averaged over events)
quantities.derivation: arccos(1/(n beta)) with n = 1.050 (ams02:C205) and beta = 0.99994534 for a muon of 10000 MeV kinetic energy (core/constants muon mass 105.6583755 MeV): 0.309674 rad (17.743 degrees)

independence.result: analytic: the Cherenkov relation with the published index, not a Geant4 output; it validates the radiator's material (index) and the tile geometry as Geant4 builds them and Geant4's Cherenkov emission angle, not the AMS ring reconstruction

quantities.tolerance_basis: fixed before any measurement: 0.5% (1.5 mrad), three times gate 2's 0.5 mrad margin; the muon's multiple scattering in 25 mm of aerogel (about 0.2 mrad) enters the mean polar angle only at second order, and 20 events of about 80 photons each give a standard error far below it

quantities.name: naf_cherenkov_angle
quantities.definition: mean polar angle, in rad, of the Cherenkov photons a 10 GeV (kinetic) mu- emits in a NaF tile, detected inside the tile's own medium
quantities.derivation: arccos(1/(n beta)) with n = 1.334 (ams02:C205) and beta = 0.99994534 (10000 MeV kinetic muon): 0.723239 rad (41.439 degrees); S01's two-decimal 1.33 would give 0.7202 rad (-0.4%)

independence.result: analytic: the Cherenkov relation with the published index, not a Geant4 output; as for the aerogel

negative_control.change: the muon at 300 MeV kinetic energy (beta = 0.9655) while the reference keeps beta of 10 GeV

quantities.tolerance_basis: fixed before any measurement: 0.5% (3.6 mrad); about 60 photons per event in 4 mm of NaF and second-order scattering keep the statistical and physical spread well inside it

approximations: the tile layout is constructed (ams02:C206: not published): the aerogel tiles on a 113 mm square lattice, 11 x 11 without its central 3 x 3, keeping the centres within 650 mm of the axis, which leaves exactly 92; the NaF tiles in a 4 x 4 array at 85 mm
the edge tiles keep their full square shape; the real ones are cut to the conical mirror (radius about 60 cm, research only)
the NaF array sits in its own 5 mm layer directly below the aerogel layer, so that its 340 mm square does not overlap the 339 mm hole of the aerogel lattice; in AMS-02 both are in one radiator plane
a constant refractive index over 2.5-3.5 eV (no dispersion, no tile-to-tile spread); no absorption or Rayleigh scattering

aerogel as silica of PDG's generic aerogel density 0.200 g/cm3 (ams02:C208; the AMS tiles' density is not in the sources read, and the 3% water is left out); NaF stoichiometric at 2.558 g/cm3 (ams02:C209, tier 6); neither density enters the angle

each tile holds a 1 mm silicon sensor at its +z face, inside the tile's medium, with a dielectric-metal skin of efficiency 1 and reflectivity 0: it stands for gate 2's measurement and is not the AMS photo-detection plane (680 PMTs 470 mm below, ams02:C70), mirror or expansion volume, none of which is modelled
the muon travels along +z, because the measure reads the angle to +z; the direction does not change an emission angle

cherenkov_handling.reason: the quantities are Cherenkov angles, for which efficiency maps do not apply (g4sim plan, Section 10.4); the radiators have no scintillation, so no efficiency map is used

status: comparison with cited values: not validated
